Commissioner Rhodes moved to approve Project SPL-21-002 based on the following: Findings: The proposed use described in the report is a permitted use within the MU-Mixed Use Zone. A public hearing was held in accordance with local and state requirements. A Certificate of Design Compliance was issued by the ARC on February 25, 2021. Commissioner Mills seconded the motion. Commission Minutes. Commissioner Chappell moved to approve the February 3, 2021, Planning Commission Meeting minutes, as amended. Commissioner Bevan seconded the motion
Commissioner Rhodes moved to adjourn. Commissioner Bevan seconded the motion
